subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: After the persistence defects are repaired, should this mutating Claws lifecycle proceed as the next stacked RFC 0016 slice, or remain paused until the RFC and read-only foundation are accepted?
rationale: The PR introduces a new environment-gated CLI lifecycle, user-config mutation, workspace ownership, and a durable state contract while RFC 0016 remains draft; repository automation cannot decide that product and sequencing commitment.

options.title: Repair, then continue the stack
options.body: Keep the PR open, require canonical schema ownership and compensating failure recovery, then review it after the RFC and read-only foundation are accepted.

options.title: Pause all mutating slices
options.body: Hold this and downstream lifecycle PRs until maintainers finalize RFC 0016 and its permanent state and upgrade boundaries.

options.title: Fold mutation into a complete lifecycle PR
options.body: Supersede this slice if maintainers require add, status, repair, and remove semantics to land atomically as one reviewed contract.

recommendation.title: Repair, then continue the stack
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, require canonical schema ownership and compensating failure recovery, then review it after the RFC and read-only foundation are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history ties the shared-state and config-mutation ownership boundary to this handle, and the live RFC discussion explicitly includes them.
